schema.name: carrier_quarantine
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE carrier_quarantine (              -- carrierQuarantineRecord: external, non-appending
  grantGeneration INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  reason     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('uncertainTailLoss','witnesslessRestore')),

schema.name: grant_journal
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE grant_journal (
  grantGeneration INTEGER NOT NULL,          -- grant generation (carrier); NOT the lifecycle install generation
  seq          INTEGER NOT NULL,             -- strictly increasing per generation
  record_type  TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (record_type IN
                 ('GRANT','NARROW','EXPIRY','RA','RCI','RCO','ICI','ICO','REV','CLN','AUD',
                  'CHECKPOINT','MIGRATION','TERMINAL')),
  operation_ref TEXT   NOT NULL,             -- operation identity value rides DR-006; structure only
  request_ref  TEXT,                         -- broker request id (RA/RCI/RCO/ICI/ICO)
  token        TEXT,                         -- PT-* on grant-bearing records
  body         TEXT    NOT NULL,             -- opensip-metadata-canonical.1 bytes, domain opensip.metadata.journal.1
  body_sha256  TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (length(body_sha256) = 64),
  prev_sha256  TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (length(prev_sha256) = 64), -- chain: sha256 of previous record's body_sha256||seq
  install_generation_id TEXT,                -- lifecycle generation the grant binds (ID-DEP-P2, recorded identity)
  manifest_digest TEXT CHECK (manifest_digest IS NULL OR length(manifest_digest) = 64),
  platform     TEXT CHECK (platform IN ('macos-arm64','macos-x86_64','linux-x86_64','linux-arm64') OR platform IS NULL),
  CHECK (record_type <> 'GRANT' OR (install_generation_id IS NOT NULL AND manifest_digest IS NOT NULL AND platform IS NOT NULL)),
  PRIMARY KEY (grantGeneration, seq)
) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: gj_no_delete
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER gj_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON grant_journal
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'grant journal is append-only'); END

schema.name: gj_no_update
schema.sql:

  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'grant journal is append-only'); END

schema.name: active_run_pins
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE active_run_pins (
 store_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(store_digest)='text' AND length(store_digest)=64 AND instr(store_digest,char(0))=0 AND store_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 namespace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(namespace)='text'),
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(run_id)='text' AND length(run_id)=69 AND instr(run_id,char(0))=0 AND run_id GLOB 'run3:*' AND substr(run_id,6) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 pin_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(pin_id)='text' AND length(CAST(pin_id AS BLOB))>0),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(kind)='text' AND kind IN ('baseline','repair-prerequisite','backup-export','other-authorized')),
 PRIMARY KEY(store_digest,namespace,run_id,pin_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: attempt_custody
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE attempt_custody (
  store_generation_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(store_generation_digest) = 'text' AND length(store_generation_digest) = 64 AND instr(store_generation_digest, char(0)) = 0 AND store_generation_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  namespace_id    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(namespace_id) = 'text' AND length(namespace_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),
  execution_id    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(execution_id) = 'text' AND length(execution_id) = 38 AND instr(execution_id, char(0)) = 0 AND execution_id GLOB 'exec1_*' AND substr(execution_id, 7) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  operation_ref   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(operation_ref) = 'text' AND length(operation_ref) = 35 AND instr(operation_ref, char(0)) = 0 AND operation_ref GLOB 'op-*' AND substr(operation_ref, 4) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  record_schema   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(record_schema) = 'integer' AND record_schema = 1),
  phase           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (phase IN ('admitted','settled')),
  settled_outcome TEXT CHECK (settled_outcome IS NULL OR settled_outcome IN ('committed','refused')),
  CHECK ((phase = 'admitted' AND settled_outcome IS NULL)
      OR (phase = 'settled'  AND settled_outcome IS NOT NULL)),
  PRIMARY KEY (store_generation_digest, namespace_id, execution_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: commit_associations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE commit_associations (
 store_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(store_digest)='text' AND length(store_digest)=64 AND instr(store_digest,char(0))=0 AND store_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 namespace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(namespace)='text'),
 execution TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(execution)='text' AND length(execution)=38 AND instr(execution,char(0))=0 AND execution GLOB 'exec1_*' AND substr(execution,7) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 commit_sequence TEXT COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(commit_sequence)='text' AND length(commit_sequence) BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND instr(commit_sequence,char(0))=0 AND commit_sequence NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND (commit_sequence='0' OR substr(commit_sequence,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9') AND (length(commit_sequence)<20 OR commit_sequence<='18446744073709551615')),
 carrier_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(carrier_digest)='text' AND length(carrier_digest)=64 AND instr(carrier_digest,char(0))=0 AND carrier_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 grant_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(grant_generation)='integer' AND grant_generation>=1),
 journal_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(journal_seq)='integer' AND journal_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740990),
 body BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(body)='blob'),
 PRIMARY KEY(store_digest,namespace,execution),
 UNIQUE(store_digest,namespace,commit_sequence),
 UNIQUE(carrier_digest,grant_generation,journal_seq)
) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: pin_change_facts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE pin_change_facts (
 store_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(store_digest)='text' AND length(store_digest)=64 AND instr(store_digest,char(0))=0 AND store_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 namespace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(namespace)='text'),
 operation_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(operation_ref)='text' AND length(operation_ref)=35 AND instr(operation_ref,char(0))=0 AND operation_ref GLOB 'op-*' AND substr(operation_ref,4) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(run_id)='text' AND length(run_id)=69 AND instr(run_id,char(0))=0 AND run_id GLOB 'run3:*' AND substr(run_id,6) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 pin_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(pin_id)='text' AND length(CAST(pin_id AS BLOB))>0),
 before_kind TEXT CHECK(before_kind IS NULL OR (typeof(before_kind)='text' AND before_kind IN ('baseline','repair-prerequisite','backup-export','other-authorized'))),
 after_kind TEXT CHECK(after_kind IS NULL OR (typeof(after_kind)='text' AND after_kind IN ('baseline','repair-prerequisite','backup-export','other-authorized'))),
 CHECK((before_kind IS NOT NULL OR after_kind IS NOT NULL) AND COALESCE(before_kind,'')<>COALESCE(after_kind,'')),
 PRIMARY KEY(store_digest,namespace,operation_ref,pin_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: ac_monotone
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ac_monotone BEFORE UPDATE ON attempt_custody
  BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.phase = 'settled'
      THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'attempt custody is already settled') END;
    SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.phase <> 'settled' OR NEW.settled_outcome IS NULL
      THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'the only lawful transition is admitted to settled') END;
    SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.store_generation_digest <> OLD.store_generation_digest
              OR NEW.namespace_id <> OLD.namespace_id
              OR NEW.execution_id <> OLD.execution_id
              OR NEW.operation_ref <> OLD.operation_ref
              OR NEW.record_schema <> OLD.record_schema
      THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'attempt custody identity is immutable') END;
  END

CREATE TRIGGER ac_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON attempt_custody
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'attempt custody is append-and-settle only'); END
